resolution.note: validator supports minItems and uniqueItems; regression test test/rules/format-contract.test.ts

title: A task created with --stack fails the format contract check
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16: krn task publish refused (pre-push fast, test/rules/format-contract.test.ts) a task created with --stack typescript: 't-7b72h2y.json.stack: unsupported keyword minItems', 'unsupported keyword uniqueItems'. spec/schema task.v1 declares them for stack, test/rules/json-schema-subset.ts does not know them, so every task with a stack fails CI.
Outcome: node --test test/rules/format-contract.test.ts exits 0, asserting: a record with stack ["typescript"] gives 0 errors; an empty stack and a duplicated stack each give 1 error.
Proof: node --test test/rules/format-contract.test.ts: pass
Files: test/rules/json-schema-subset.ts, test/rules/format-contract.test.ts
